messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (P1) — High error rate and increased tail latency for inference in us-east-1a. Autoscaling not bringing up new hosts; ENI attach failures observed. Please respond.

maria_oncall: I'm here. Seeing 5xx spikes, traffic dropped to fallback model for some customers. Pulling logs now.

devon_sre: Confirming ENI attach throttling in CloudTrail. Affected ASG attempts failing with AttachNetworkInterfaceRateExceeded. Looks zonal (us-east-1a).

arjun_netops: AWS health dashboard shows an isolated capacity and networking issue in us-east-1a. Not a full AZ outage but elevated ENI API errors.

sasha_runtime: Rolling request-level fallback to smaller quantized model in us-east-1b/c where possible. Pushing routing policy change to avoid us-east-1a for new requests.

maria_oncall: Support lead, can you surface which customers are currently routed to us-east-1a? We need impact scope.

support_lead: Quick list from route logs: three enterprise accounts (acme-inc, mediSys, searchly) have a non-trivial percentage still pinned. Most self-serve traffic is rebalanced. Notifying customer success for acme-inc and mediSys.

devon_sre: Temporary mitigation suggestions: 1) Pause scale-up attempts in the us-east-1a ASGs to avoid constant ENI retries. 2) Increase cross-AZ routing weight to us-east-1b/c. 3) Reduce DNS TTL for region endpoints to 30s for faster propagation if we need to redirect clients.

maria_oncall: I'm pausing the ASG scale activity for the affected pools now: `aws autoscaling suspend-processes --auto-scaling-group-name inference-pool-us-east-1a --scaling-processes Launch`

sasha_runtime: Applying routing policy change: bump us-east-1b weight from 40 -> 80, us-east-1c 20 -> 80, us-east-1a -> 0 for inference-route. Command: `rdwctl routing set-weight --route inference-route --region us-east-1a --weight 0` (dry-run then apply).

arjun_netops: Also opened support case with AWS (case 1234567890). AWS asked for ENI attach error logs and rate of attempts. They flagged ENI API throttling for the AZ.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline paused for all canaries targeting us-east-1a.

maria_oncall: Handoff plan: I'm going offline for a scheduled appointment in ~30m. devon, can you take the on-call ownership after I sign out? I'll leave runbook notes below.

devon_sre: I can take it. maria, leave the runbook steps and what you want followed for escalation.

maria_oncall: Runbook snippet: 
- Pause ASG scale for affected pools (done).
- Update routing weights away from us-east-1a (in progress).
- If customer latency > 3s or error rate > 10% for enterprise accounts, notify customer success + sales engineer.
- If ENI attach errors persist > 1hr after AWS mitigations, consider cross-region evacuations for critical customers and enable reserved capacity in us-west-2 as temporary lane.

support_lead: Notified Acme and MediSys about degraded throughput. They reported increased latencies but no data loss. Searchly on the free tier — no action yet.

devon_sre: Routing change applied and validated for control traffic. Edge health checks show steady decrease of traffic to us-east-1a. Canary probe latency in 1b/c looks good.

arjun_netops: AWS responded: they're seeing ENI throttling due to elevated attach rates in an internal tenant; their mitigation is gradually raising attach API quotas for the AZ and patching a noisy tenant. ETA unclear but said "mitigation in progress".

maria_oncall: Customer impact assessment (early): 
- P1: Acme-inc (critical inference pipelines) — partial degradation, ~25% of requests retried, fallback applied, degraded SLA risk.
- P2: MediSys — increased latency, non-blocking for some workflows.
- P3: Self-serve and searchly — small percentage saw slowed responses; auto-rebalance handled most.

sasha_runtime: Workaround for pinned customers: we can force a model routing override per-tenant by setting tenant routing policy to prefer us-east-1b/c. That will cause cold-start for some models. Do we have approval to do per-tenant overrides for Acme?

support_lead: Acme wants auto-failover now. They approved any change that reduces SLA risk. MediSys asked to be kept informed.

devon_sre: Taking over on-call. I'll monitor AWS case and continue communications. Next steps: 1) Keep ASG paused. 2) Keep routing weight at 0 for 1a. 3) If AWS mitigation not confirmed within 45m, start cross-region capacity plan for Acme (notify infra-sig).

maria_oncall: Thanks devon — handoff complete. I'm leaving the channel. :wave:

devon_sre: Acknowledged. Updating incident status: status=mitigating, assigned=devon_sre. Will update every 15 min or on AWS case update.

incident-bot: Incident log created: INC-2026-045 (us-east-1a ENI throttling impacting inference). Severity P1 for Acme.

arjun_netops: FYI, we found a path to reduce attach attempts from our side by increasing local warm pool for affected instance types (g4dn warm-pool). Starting a warm-pool fill to avoid new ENI attach calls.

sasha_runtime: Also enabling prefetched KV cache in 1b/c to reduce cold-start token cost for routed requests.

support_lead: Customer success is on standby for Acme. Notifying legal for potential SLA credits if we hit breach.

devon_sre: Update 15m: AWS says mitigation progressing, attach error rate trending down. Traffic now ~95% away from 1a. Monitoring.

maria_oncall: (post-handoff) quick note — if attach errors come back, don't re-enable ASG scaling; coordinate with arjun to request AWS throttling lift.

devon_sre: Will do. Next update or closure will be posted here.

support_lead: Closing loop with Acme: they confirm better performance, still watching overnight.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 moved to status=monitoring by devon_sre.

devon_sre: Incident resolved (aws mitigation confirmed + traffic normalized) at final check. Will file a short postmortem and flag follow-ups: - reduce ENI attach churn during scale - increase warm pool sizes for critical instance types - add routing circuit-breaker to auto-drain problematic AZs.

sasha_runtime: Filing followups in eng-runtime board.

arjun_netops: AWS case closed by AWS with root cause: internal tenant causing ENI API hot-spot in us-east-1a; they added temporary capacity and rate smoothing.

devon_sre: Thanks team. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
